title: How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?
question:
How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Between August And November 2013 refers to Between 201308 And 201311; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.

prediction.sql:
SELECT SUM(T1.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS T1
WHERE T1.XCL_019 = 6
